opening.argument: The stated offer is a $50 Victoria's Secret gift-card raffle tied only to ordinary audience-engagement actions. Viewers are told to “sub sub to the channel, like and comment, share it, and turn on notifications,” and those actions provide an entry number. The speaker further describes using a random generator at the end of the raffle so that somebody receives the card. Nothing in the evidence requests payment, investment, credentials, or private data. The fulfillment, organizer identity, and eventual winner are not established, but those limitations do not convert the described promotion into a demonstrated financial-solicitation mechanism.
